chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Mas'ada ibn Sadaqa, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever wakes up and goes to sleep with three things, the blessing is complete for him in the world: whoever wakes up and goes to sleep with good health in his body, security in his flock, and his day's provisions with him. If he has the fourth, the blessing is complete for him in the world and the Hereafter, and it is Islam.'
ai.seo_question: What are the four conditions for complete blessing in Islam according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the Prophet’s definition of complete blessing, emphasizing that physical well-being, security of one's livelihood, and daily sustenance constitute the foundation of worldly contentment. The inclusion of 'Islam' as the fourth element signifies that true perfection is achieved when these material blessings are anchored in the faith, thereby securing both dunya and akhirah. This hadith reflects the Shia emphasis on the harmony between material gratitude and spiritual submission, a concept deeply rooted in the teachings of the Ahl al-Bayt.
